Requirements.name: Requirements
Requirements.documentation: Stakeholder requirements and user stories for a compact battery-electric passenger car. Size, performance, safety and security are the requirement groups. Driving, charging and parking are told as user stories. Leaf requirements refine a group. Logical parts satisfy the leaves.

Requirements::Size.name: Size
Requirements::Size.documentation: The car shall fit a compact passenger-car envelope and carry people and luggage.

Requirements::VehicleLength.name: VehicleLength
Requirements::VehicleLength.documentation: The vehicle shall be at most 4.5 m long.

Requirements::VehicleWidth.name: VehicleWidth
Requirements::VehicleWidth.documentation: The vehicle shall be at most 1.85 m wide, excluding mirrors.

Requirements::VehicleHeight.name: VehicleHeight
Requirements::VehicleHeight.documentation: The vehicle shall be at most 1.6 m high.

Requirements::PassengerCapacity.name: PassengerCapacity
Requirements::PassengerCapacity.documentation: The vehicle shall seat at least four occupants.

Requirements::CargoVolume.name: CargoVolume
Requirements::CargoVolume.documentation: The vehicle shall provide at least 300 litres of cargo volume behind the rear seats.

Requirements::Performance.name: Performance
Requirements::Performance.documentation: The car shall deliver everyday range, acceleration, speed and charging.

Requirements::Range.name: Range
Requirements::Range.documentation: The vehicle shall travel at least 350 km on a full charge in the WLTP cycle.

Requirements::Acceleration.name: Acceleration
Requirements::Acceleration.documentation: The vehicle shall accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in at most 8 seconds.

Requirements::TopSpeed.name: TopSpeed
Requirements::TopSpeed.documentation: The vehicle shall be capable of at least 160 km/h.

Requirements::ChargeTime.name: ChargeTime
Requirements::ChargeTime.documentation: The battery shall charge from 10 percent to 80 percent in at most 30 minutes on DC fast charge.

Requirements::PropulsionModes.name: PropulsionModes
Requirements::PropulsionModes.documentation: The driver shall be able to select park, reverse, neutral and drive.

Requirements::Safety.name: Safety
Requirements::Safety.documentation: The car shall protect occupants and people outside the vehicle.

Requirements::CrashProtection.name: CrashProtection
Requirements::CrashProtection.documentation: The occupant cell shall remain intact in the applicable frontal and side impact tests.

Requirements::BrakingDistance.name: BrakingDistance
Requirements::BrakingDistance.documentation: The vehicle shall stop from 100 km/h within 40 m on dry pavement.

Requirements::PedestrianProtection.name: PedestrianProtection
Requirements::PedestrianProtection.documentation: The front structure shall reduce pedestrian leg and head injury in a frontal impact.

Requirements::OccupantRestraint.name: OccupantRestraint
Requirements::OccupantRestraint.documentation: Every seating position shall have a seat belt and be covered by an airbag.

Requirements::DirectionalControl.name: DirectionalControl
Requirements::DirectionalControl.documentation: The vehicle shall follow the steering angle commanded by the driver.

Requirements::ForwardVisibility.name: ForwardVisibility
Requirements::ForwardVisibility.documentation: The driver shall be able to clear the windshield while driving.

Requirements::Security.name: Security
Requirements::Security.documentation: The car shall unlock, lock and immobilize only for an authenticated driver.

Requirements::AccessControl.name: AccessControl
Requirements::AccessControl.documentation: Doors shall unlock only after the driver credential has been authenticated.

Requirements::Immobilizer.name: Immobilizer
Requirements::Immobilizer.documentation: Propulsion shall stay inhibited until the driver has been authenticated.

Requirements::LockIndication.name: LockIndication
Requirements::LockIndication.documentation: The driver shall receive a confirmation when the vehicle is locked.

Requirements::DriveToDestination.name: DriveToDestination
Requirements::DriveToDestination.documentation: As a driver I want to drive from origin to destination so that I can travel on battery power alone.

Requirements::ControlSpeed.name: ControlSpeed
Requirements::ControlSpeed.documentation: As a driver I want to accelerate and brake smoothly so that I stay comfortable in traffic.

Requirements::FollowTheRoad.name: FollowTheRoad
Requirements::FollowTheRoad.documentation: As a driver I want to turn left and right so that I can follow the road.

Requirements::ChargeAtHome.name: ChargeAtHome
Requirements::ChargeAtHome.documentation: As a driver I want to charge overnight at home so that the car is ready in the morning.

Requirements::ChargeAway.name: ChargeAway
Requirements::ChargeAway.documentation: As a driver I want to fast-charge during a trip so that I can continue when the battery is low.

Requirements::ParkAndLeave.name: ParkAndLeave
Requirements::ParkAndLeave.documentation: As a driver I want to park, select park and lock the car so that it stays where I left it.

Requirements::EnjoyTheCabin.name: EnjoyTheCabin
Requirements::EnjoyTheCabin.documentation: As a passenger I want climate and entertainment during the trip so that the journey stays comfortable.

Requirements::RequirementsGraphView.name: RequirementsGraphView
Requirements::RequirementsGraphView.documentation: Requirement graph. Group requirements, leaf requirements and user stories, with «refine» dependencies.

Requirements::RequirementsTableView.name: RequirementsTableView
Requirements::RequirementsTableView.documentation: Requirement table. Flat list or hierarchy following «refine» links. User stories carry Type UserStory.

Functions.name: Functions
Functions.documentation: Functional architecture of the electric car. Each function is a part. A dashed «keyword» dependency points from the function that needs another function to the function it depends on. Security and Charging are roots: driving, comfort and visibility depend on an authenticated vehicle and on energy.

Functions::Security.name: Security
Functions::Security.documentation: Authenticate the driver, unlock and lock the doors, and release the immobilizer. Every driving function depends on Security before the car will move.

Functions::Charging.name: Charging
Functions::Charging.documentation: Take energy from a home or fast charger and store it in the battery. Speed control, climate, entertainment, lighting and windshield cleaning draw on this energy.

Functions::SpeedControl.name: SpeedControl
Functions::SpeedControl.documentation: Command traction torque and braking, including regenerative braking, so the driver can set and hold speed. Depends on Security for the immobilizer and on Charging for energy.

Functions::Maneuvrability.name: Maneuvrability
Functions::Maneuvrability.documentation: Steer the car left and right and keep it directionally stable. Depends on Security, and on SpeedControl because steering response changes with speed.

Functions::Entertainment.name: Entertainment
Functions::Entertainment.documentation: Play audio and video for the driver and passengers. Depends on Security so the cabin systems wake only for an authorized user, and on Charging for power.

Functions::Climate.name: Climate
Functions::Climate.documentation: Heat, cool and demist the cabin. Depends on Charging because the compressor and heater are electric.

Functions::WindshieldCleaning.name: WindshieldCleaning
Functions::WindshieldCleaning.documentation: Wipe and wash the windshield so the driver can see. Depends on Charging for the wiper motor and on SpeedControl so the wipe rate can follow vehicle speed.

Functions::Lighting.name: Lighting
Functions::Lighting.documentation: Headlamps, tail lamps and direction indicators. Depends on Security and Charging. Indicators also depend on Maneuvrability because they follow the intended turn.

Functions::FunctionsView.name: FunctionsView
Functions::FunctionsView.documentation: Functional dependency view. Arrows are «Authorize», «Energy», «Stability», «Speed» and «Indicate» dependencies.

UseCases.name: UseCases
UseCases.documentation: Use cases for driving, charging and parking an electric car. Actors are the driver and the passenger. Drive includes the manoeuvres it is made of. Park includes Lock. EmergencyStop extends Brake. Each use case names the requirement it pursues.

UseCases::ElectricCar.name: ElectricCar
UseCases::ElectricCar.documentation: The battery-electric passenger car that is the subject of these use cases.

UseCases::Unlock.name: Unlock
UseCases::Unlock.documentation: The driver authenticates and the doors unlock.

UseCases::Lock.name: Lock
UseCases::Lock.documentation: The driver locks the car and receives confirmation.

UseCases::ChangeGear.name: ChangeGear
UseCases::ChangeGear.documentation: The driver selects park, reverse, neutral or drive.

UseCases::TurnLeft.name: TurnLeft
UseCases::TurnLeft.documentation: The driver turns the steering wheel left and the car follows.

UseCases::TurnRight.name: TurnRight
UseCases::TurnRight.documentation: The driver turns the steering wheel right and the car follows.

UseCases::Brake.name: Brake
UseCases::Brake.documentation: The driver presses the brake pedal and the car slows, using the friction brakes and the motor.

UseCases::Accelerate.name: Accelerate
UseCases::Accelerate.documentation: The driver presses the accelerator and the motor delivers torque.

UseCases::EmergencyStop.name: EmergencyStop
UseCases::EmergencyStop.documentation: The driver brakes hard from speed. Extends Brake with maximum deceleration.

UseCases::Charge.name: Charge
UseCases::Charge.documentation: The driver connects a charger at home or at a fast charger and the battery takes energy.

UseCases::AdjustClimate.name: AdjustClimate
UseCases::AdjustClimate.documentation: The driver or a passenger sets cabin temperature and airflow.

UseCases::PlayMedia.name: PlayMedia
UseCases::PlayMedia.documentation: The driver or a passenger plays audio or video on the cabin system.

UseCases::CleanWindshield.name: CleanWindshield
UseCases::CleanWindshield.documentation: The driver starts the wipers and the windshield is cleared.

UseCases::Drive.name: Drive
UseCases::Drive.documentation: The driver takes the car from origin to destination. Includes gear selection, speed control and steering. The passenger rides along.

UseCases::Park.name: Park
UseCases::Park.documentation: The driver stops, selects park and locks the car. Includes Lock.

UseCases::VehicleUseCaseView.name: VehicleUseCaseView
UseCases::VehicleUseCaseView.documentation: Use-case diagram. Driver and passenger are associated with the cases they take part in. «include» and «extend» relate the cases.

LogicalArchitecture.name: LogicalArchitecture
LogicalArchitecture.documentation: Logical architecture of the electric car. Car is the assembly. Parts are logical, not yet software, electronics or metal. Dependencies show what is mounted on what, what commands what, and what supplies energy. Interfaces name the contracts. Each contract has a provider port (Out) and a consumer port (In), joined by a connection. The physical architecture realizes these parts with «implements».

LogicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.name: DirectionCommand
LogicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.documentation: Steering command. The steering control provides it and the road wheels consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::GearCommand.name: GearCommand
LogicalArchitecture::GearCommand.documentation: Park, reverse, neutral or drive. The gear selector provides it and the traction motor consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.name: TorqueRequest
LogicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.documentation: Requested traction torque. The accelerator provides it and the traction motor consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.name: BrakeRequest
LogicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.documentation: Requested deceleration. The brake pedal provides it and the road wheels consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.name: EnergySupply
LogicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.documentation: Traction energy. The battery provides it. The motor, climate, entertainment and lamps consume it.

LogicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.name: ChargeFeed
LogicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.documentation: Energy from an external charger. The charge inlet provides it and the battery consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.name: WindshieldClear
LogicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.documentation: Wiping action. The wipers provide it and the windshield consumes it.

LogicalArchitecture::Car.name: Car
LogicalArchitecture::Car.documentation: Logical electric car: driver controls, traction, energy, body and cabin systems.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::steeringWheel.name: steeringWheel
LogicalArchitecture::Car::steeringWheel.documentation: Driver control for direction. Provides DirectionCommand to the road wheels.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::gearStick.name: gearStick
LogicalArchitecture::Car::gearStick.documentation: Driver control for park, reverse, neutral and drive. Provides GearCommand to the motor.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::acceleratorPed.name: acceleratorPedal
LogicalArchitecture::Car::acceleratorPed.documentation: Driver control for requested traction torque. Provides TorqueRequest to the motor.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::brakePedal.name: brakePedal
LogicalArchitecture::Car::brakePedal.documentation: Driver control for deceleration. Provides BrakeRequest to the wheels.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::climateSystem.name: climateSystem
LogicalArchitecture::Car::climateSystem.documentation: Logical heating, ventilation and cooling of the cabin. Consumes EnergySupply from the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::entertainmentS.name: entertainmentSystem
LogicalArchitecture::Car::entertainmentS.documentation: Logical cabin audio and video. Consumes EnergySupply from the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::engine.name: engine
LogicalArchitecture::Car::engine.documentation: Electric traction motor, nominally 150 kW. Consumes GearCommand, TorqueRequest and EnergySupply.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::battery.name: battery
LogicalArchitecture::Car::battery.documentation: Traction battery, nominally 60 kWh. Provides EnergySupply and consumes ChargeFeed.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::chargeInlet.name: chargeInlet
LogicalArchitecture::Car::chargeInlet.documentation: Inlet where a home or DC charger connects. Provides ChargeFeed to the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::chassis.name: chassis
LogicalArchitecture::Car::chassis.documentation: Structural backbone. The motor, battery, suspension and body are mounted on it.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::wheels.name: wheels
LogicalArchitecture::Car::wheels.documentation: Road wheels that accelerate, brake and steer the car. Consume DirectionCommand and BrakeRequest.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::suspension.name: suspension
LogicalArchitecture::Car::suspension.documentation: Links the wheels to the chassis and keeps the tyres on the road.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::windows.name: windows
LogicalArchitecture::Car::windows.documentation: Side and rear glazing in the body shell.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::body.name: body
LogicalArchitecture::Car::body.documentation: Body shell (kaross). Sets length, width, height, seating and cargo volume, and forms the occupant cell.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::windshield.name: windshield
LogicalArchitecture::Car::windshield.documentation: Front glass. Consumes WindshieldClear from the wipers.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::wipers.name: wipers
LogicalArchitecture::Car::wipers.documentation: Wiper and washer mechanism on the body. Provides WindshieldClear to the windshield.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::locks.name: locks
LogicalArchitecture::Car::locks.documentation: Door locks. Enforce access control, the immobilizer interlock and lock confirmation.

LogicalArchitecture::Car::lamps.name: lamps
LogicalArchitecture::Car::lamps.documentation: Headlamps, tail lamps and direction indicators. Consume EnergySupply from the battery.

LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalView.name: CarLogicalView
LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalView.documentation: Logical whitebox of Car. Nested parts, provider and consumer ports, the connections between them, and «Command», «Energy», «Mount», «Support» and «Clear» dependencies.

LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalTree.name: CarLogicalTree
LogicalArchitecture::CarLogicalTree.documentation: Containment tree of the logical car.

Dynamics.name: Dynamics
Dynamics.documentation: Sequence diagrams for the use cases. Each interaction is one use case: who asks, which controller decides, and which logical part responds. Lifelines are roles in the scenario, not a second architecture.

Dynamics::UnlockSequence.name: UnlockSequence
Dynamics::UnlockSequence.documentation: Unlock. The driver presents a credential, access control authenticates it, and the door locks release.

Dynamics::LockSequence.name: LockSequence
Dynamics::LockSequence.documentation: Lock. The driver requests lock, the latches engage, and the car confirms it is locked.

Dynamics::ChangeGearSequence.name: ChangeGearSequence
Dynamics::ChangeGearSequence.documentation: Change gear. The driver moves the gear stick and the maneuvrability controller sets the motor mode.

Dynamics::TurnLeftSequence.name: TurnLeftSequence
Dynamics::TurnLeftSequence.documentation: Turn left. Steering-wheel angle becomes a wheel angle through the maneuvrability controller.

Dynamics::TurnRightSequence.name: TurnRightSequence
Dynamics::TurnRightSequence.documentation: Turn right. Same path as turn left, with the opposite angle.

Dynamics::BrakeSequence.name: BrakeSequence
Dynamics::BrakeSequence.documentation: Brake. Pedal force becomes a deceleration request, then regenerative torque and slower wheels.

Dynamics::AccelerateSequence.name: AccelerateSequence
Dynamics::AccelerateSequence.documentation: Accelerate. Pedal travel becomes a torque request, the battery supplies power, and the motor drives the wheels.

Dynamics::EmergencyStopSequence.name: EmergencyStopSequence
Dynamics::EmergencyStopSequence.documentation: Emergency stop. Extends braking: the driver brakes hard and the speed controller commands maximum deceleration.

Dynamics::ChargeSequence.name: ChargeSequence
Dynamics::ChargeSequence.documentation: Charge. The driver connects the plug, the battery controller starts the session, and the battery reports state of charge.

Dynamics::ParkSequence.name: ParkSequence
Dynamics::ParkSequence.documentation: Park. The driver selects park, holds the brake, and the car locks.

Dynamics::AdjustClimateSequence.name: AdjustClimateSequence
Dynamics::AdjustClimateSequence.documentation: Adjust climate. The driver sets a temperature and the climate controller drives the HVAC unit.

Dynamics::PlayMediaSequence.name: PlayMediaSequence
Dynamics::PlayMediaSequence.documentation: Play media. The passenger selects a title and the entertainment controller shows it.

Dynamics::CleanWindshieldSequence.name: CleanWindshieldSequence
Dynamics::CleanWindshieldSequence.documentation: Clean the windshield. The driver requests a wipe and the mechanism sweeps the glass.

Dynamics::UnlockSequenceView.name: UnlockSequenceView
Dynamics::UnlockSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the Unlock use case.

Dynamics::LockSequenceView.name: LockSequenceView
Dynamics::LockSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the Lock use case.

Dynamics::ChangeGearSequenceView.name: ChangeGearSequenceView
Dynamics::ChangeGearSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the ChangeGear use case.

Dynamics::TurnLeftSequenceView.name: TurnLeftSequenceView
Dynamics::TurnLeftSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the TurnLeft use case.

Dynamics::TurnRightSequenceView.name: TurnRightSequenceView
Dynamics::TurnRightSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the TurnRight use case.

Dynamics::BrakeSequenceView.name: BrakeSequenceView
Dynamics::BrakeSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the Brake use case.

Dynamics::AccelerateSequenceView.name: AccelerateSequenceView
Dynamics::AccelerateSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the Accelerate use case.

Dynamics::EmergencyStopSequenceView.name: EmergencyStopSequenceView
Dynamics::EmergencyStopSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the EmergencyStop use case.

Dynamics::ChargeSequenceView.name: ChargeSequenceView
Dynamics::ChargeSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the Charge use case.

Dynamics::ParkSequenceView.name: ParkSequenceView
Dynamics::ParkSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the Park use case.

Dynamics::AdjustClimateSequenceView.name: AdjustClimateSequenceView
Dynamics::AdjustClimateSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the AdjustClimate use case.

Dynamics::PlayMediaSequenceView.name: PlayMediaSequenceView
Dynamics::PlayMediaSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the PlayMedia use case.

Dynamics::CleanWindshieldSequenceView.name: CleanWindshieldSequenceView
Dynamics::CleanWindshieldSequenceView.documentation: Sequence for the CleanWindshield use case.

PhysicalArchitecture.name: PhysicalArchitecture
PhysicalArchitecture.documentation: Physical architecture of the electric car. Software components run on embedded controllers. Climate and entertainment share one computer. Maneuvrability, engine and battery each have their own. Everything else is mechanical. Every physical part has an «implements» dependency to the logical part it realizes. The same interface contracts as the logical architecture are realized here: a provider port (Out) and a consumer port (In) on the physical parts that play those roles. Parts marked «Logical» are the logical counterparts, drawn here so the realization is visible.

PhysicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.name: DirectionCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::DirectionCommand.documentation: Steering command, same contract as the logical architecture. The maneuvrability controller provides it and the wheels consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::GearCommand.name: GearCommand
PhysicalArchitecture::GearCommand.documentation: Gear selection, same contract as the logical architecture. The gear selector provides it and the engine controller consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.name: TorqueRequest
PhysicalArchitecture::TorqueRequest.documentation: Torque request, same contract as the logical architecture. The accelerator provides it and the engine controller consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.name: BrakeRequest
PhysicalArchitecture::BrakeRequest.documentation: Brake request, same contract as the logical architecture. The brake pedal provides it and the wheels consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.name: EnergySupply
PhysicalArchitecture::EnergySupply.documentation: Traction energy, same contract as the logical architecture. The battery controller provides it. The motor, climate hardware, display and lamps consume it.

PhysicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.name: ChargeFeed
PhysicalArchitecture::ChargeFeed.documentation: External charge energy, same contract as the logical architecture. The charge inlet provides it and the battery controller consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.name: WindshieldClear
PhysicalArchitecture::WindshieldClear.documentation: Wiping action, same contract as the logical architecture. The wiper assembly provides it and the windshield consumes it.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical.name: VehiclePhysical
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical.documentation: Physical car: embedded controllers with their software, and the mechanical parts. Implements the logical Car.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: infotainmentEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Embedded computer shared by the entertainment software and the climate software. Implements the logical entertainment system and the logical climate system.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: entertainmentSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Software component for the cabin audio and video. Hosted on the infotainment computer. Implements the logical entertainment system.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.name: climateControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::i.documentation: Software component for cabin heating, cooling and airflow. Hosted on the infotainment computer, together with entertainment. Implements the logical climate system.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::m.name: maneuvrabilityEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::m.documentation: Embedded computer for steering. Separate from the other controllers. Implements the logical steering wheel's control path.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::m.name: maneuvrabilityControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::m.documentation: Software component for steering angle and directional control. Consumes the driver's DirectionCommand and provides it to the wheels.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: engineEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Embedded computer for the traction motor. Separate module. Implements the logical engine.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: engineControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Software component for motor torque and mode. Consumes GearCommand and TorqueRequest.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: batteryEcu
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Embedded computer for the traction battery and charging. Separate module. Implements the logical battery.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: batteryControlSw
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Software component for battery limits and charge sessions. Provides EnergySupply and consumes ChargeFeed.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: steeringWheelMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Mechanical steering wheel. Provides DirectionCommand to the maneuvrability controller.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::g.name: gearStickMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::g.documentation: Mechanical gear selector for park, reverse, neutral and drive. Provides GearCommand.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::h.name: hvacAssembly
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::h.documentation: Mechanical climate hardware: heater, compressor, fans and ducts. Consumes EnergySupply.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: displayAndSpeakers
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Mechanical and electronic cabin display and speakers. Consumes EnergySupply.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: electricMotor
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Mechanical traction motor. Consumes EnergySupply. The engine computer commands it.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: batteryPack
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Mechanical battery pack. Implements the logical battery. The battery computer manages it.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: chassisFrame
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Mechanical chassis frame. Implements the logical chassis.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: wheelSet
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Mechanical road wheels. Consume DirectionCommand and BrakeRequest.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: suspensionAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Mechanical suspension. Implements the logical suspension.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: windowAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Mechanical side and rear windows. Implements the logical windows.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: bodyShell
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Mechanical body shell (kaross). Implements the logical body.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: wiperAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Mechanical wiper and washer. Provides WindshieldClear.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.name: doorLockAsm
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::d.documentation: Mechanical door locks. Implements the logical locks.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: chargeInletMech
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Mechanical charge inlet socket. Provides ChargeFeed to the battery controller.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: car
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Logical Car. The whole physical car implements this assembly.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: steeringWheel
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Logical steering wheel, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::g.name: gearStick
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::g.documentation: Logical gear stick, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::a.name: acceleratorPedal
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::a.documentation: Logical accelerator pedal, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: brakePedal
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Logical brake pedal, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: climateSystem
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Logical climate system, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: entertainmentSystem
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Logical entertainment system, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.name: engine
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::e.documentation: Logical engine (traction motor), from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: battery
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Logical battery, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: chassis
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Logical chassis, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: wheels
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Logical wheels, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.name: suspension
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::s.documentation: Logical suspension, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: windows
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Logical windows, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.name: body
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::b.documentation: Logical body shell (kaross), from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: windshield
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Logical windshield, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.name: wipers
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::w.documentation: Logical wipers, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::l.name: locks
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::l.documentation: Logical locks, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::l.name: lamps
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::l.documentation: Logical lamps, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.name: chargeInlet
PhysicalArchitecture::VehiclePhysical::c.documentation: Logical charge inlet, from the logical architecture.

PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalView.name: PhysicalView
PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalView.documentation: Physical whitebox. Software nested in its computer, mechanical parts beside them, provider and consumer ports with their connections, and «implements» arrows to the «Logical» counterparts. Climate and entertainment share infotainmentEcu.

PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalTree.name: PhysicalTree
PhysicalArchitecture::PhysicalTree.documentation: Containment tree of the physical car, including software hosted on each computer.
